description.value:
The only one of its kind, made specially for rockerboy Johnny Silverhand. Semiautomatic, equipped with a prototype smart link and compatible with various ammunition types, it sports three firing modes – ricochet, wall penetration and incendiary rounds. Plus, the collector's value is through the roof.

“Wake the fuck up, Samurai. We’ve got a city to burn.”

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 15,000eb - 3 Months

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell (6d6, expends entire magazine, sets damaged targets Seriously on Fire, uses the Handgun Skill)

Concealable: Nah, Choom. You got to wear it with pride.

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Biometric Lock, TUp (Can see simple target outlines through and fire through up to one layer of Thin Cover) Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link (w/ Advanced Smartlink) • Mods: None

Special Features: Despite being Iconic, this weapon may load Non-Basic Ammunition. All ammunition fired by this weapon also functions as Armor-Piercing Ammunition. When firing this weapon, if the user rolls a Critical Failure (1) during their Attack Check, they do not roll an implosion d10 [Advanced Smartlink]. Provides a +2 bonus to Wardrobe and Style Checks if worn openly, or +4 if at any location favorited by only the truest of Cyberpunks.

Fabrication: DV29 - 15,000eb - 3 Months
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Biometric Lock, TUp (Can see simple target outlines through and fire through up to one layer of Thin Cover) Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link (w/ Advanced Smartlink) (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell (6d6, expends entire magazine, sets damaged targets Seriously on Fire, uses the Handgun Skill)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
